svg.title: OneStep — Level 4: Code of the checkout and order component

g.text: OneStep — Level 4: Code of the checkout and order component
The classes behind "Place order" and order tracking
Subtotal, DiscountTotal, ShippingCost, TaxAmount, TotalAmount : decimal
PlaceOrderAsync: check stock → price the cart → CheckoutCalculator →
copy names, prices and address into the order → take stock →
first history row → empty the cart → ONE SaveChanges (one transaction).
If another customer changed the stock meanwhile, RowVersion → 409 Conflict.
